Legacy colour attributes

HTML's presentational colour attributes and SVG's presentation attributes are ADR 0004 tier 2: their whole value is the value, so there is no declaration boundary to anchor and the selector is a plain exact match. Nothing else in the corpus carries them, which means every tier-2 path — the themeAs/emitAs split, the value repair, the element-type qualifiers — had no browser coverage at all.

They are still honoured by every browser and still common in email templates, older CMS output, and generated report tables.

bgcolor — with and without the # the spec does not require

bgcolor="#ffffff" bgcolor="ffffff" bgcolor="fff" bgcolor="white"
